text: Hi Professor Alvarez — I'd like to book my 30-minute 1:1 for next week. What times work for you? I'm free in my usual working hours, Monday–Friday 09:00–17:00.
Hi Sarah — happy to. I've put you down for **Monday 10:00-10:30** next week. It's on my calendar; let me know if that clashes and I'll find another free slot.

Dear Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. Looking at my calendar, the free half-hours I have are:

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Monday 14:00-14:30
- Wednesday 10:00-10:30
- Wednesday 13:00-13:30
- Wednesday 15:00-15:30

Would one of those suit you? If you'd rather name another time, I'll see whether I can free it up.

Best,
John

Hello Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. I'm free on:

- Monday 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30
- Wednesday 13:00-13:30 or 15:00-15:30
- Thursday 10:00-10:30

Would any of those work for you? If not, tell me what suits you better and I'll fit around it.

One check: my calendar already shows "Advisor 1:1" blocks (Mon 09:00-10:00, Wed 16:30-17:00, Thu 14:20-15:20, Fri 09:00-10:00). Is one of those our 1:1 for next week, or should I add a new 30-minute slot?

Best,
Priya
Dear John — Monday 10:00 has just gone to Sarah, so let's take **Monday 14:00-14:30**. It's on my calendar now; if anything shifts on your side, tell me and I'll fit you in another free half-hour.
Monday 10:00-10:30 works for me — thanks for putting it in. See you then.

Hello Priya — **Wednesday 13:00-13:30** works for me; it's on my calendar now. Monday is fully spoken for at those two times.

On your check: I have no 1:1 for you down for next week yet, so please add this new 30-minute block on Wednesday 13:00. The "Advisor 1:1" blocks already in your own calendar aren't this booking — if you're unsure where they came from, it's worth checking before you keep them.

Thank you, Professor — Monday 14:00-14:30 works. It's on my calendar now, and I've logged it. If anything shifts on my side I'll let you know straight away.

Best,
John

Thank you — Wednesday 13:00-13:30 is booked and logged on my side. I've added it as a new 30-minute block alongside my lunch (11:50-13:00), so Wednesday now reads: ... 11:50-13:00 Lunch, 13:00-13:30 Advisor 1:1, 13:30-14:30 Research group meeting.

On the older "Advisor 1:1" blocks: understood, and I won't remove them on a hunch. I'll check with the department office whether they're official events on the record, and I'll come back to you if they turn out to be ours.

Best,
Priya

Hello,

A question about my schedule for next week. My calendar has four "Advisor 1:1" blocks in it (Monday 09:00-10:00, Wednesday 16:30-17:00, Thursday 14:20-15:20, Friday 09:00-10:00), and I'm not sure where they came from — Professor Alvarez has no 1:1 with me down for next week.

Could you tell me whether those blocks are official department events on your record, or whether I should treat them as something else (and possibly move them)? I've just booked my own 30-minute 1:1 with Professor Alvarez for Wednesday 13:00-13:30.

Thank you,
Priya

Hello Priya,

Those four "Advisor 1:1" blocks are not on the department's official schedule — nothing of that name is recorded for next week, so they are not official events and are yours to treat as your own commitments (you may move them).

One thing worth knowing: each of those blocks falls in a time the official schedule already gives to Professor Alvarez — Mon 09:00-10:00, Wed 16:30-17:00, Thu 14:20-15:20 and Fri 09:00-10:00 are Curriculum committee times. So a 1:1 in any of them could not stand anyway.

Your Wednesday 13:00-13:30 booking: that half hour is free on the official record, but a meeting is booked only once every participant has it on their calendar — check that Professor Alvarez has it on his.

Best,
Department office

Thank you — that's clear. I'll leave those four blocks in place for now and check with Professor Alvarez rather than quietly deleting them; I'll sort them out with him.

On Wednesday: Professor Alvarez confirmed in writing that 13:00-13:30 is on his calendar, so that one is booked on both sides.

Best,
Priya

Noted — thanks. Wednesday 13:00-13:30 is free on the official record, so if it is on Professor Alvarez's calendar too, the 1:1 is booked on both sides.

Best,
Department office

One follow-up, and no action needed from you right now.

The department office tells me the four old "Advisor 1:1" blocks on my calendar (Mon 09:00-10:00, Wed 16:30-17:00, Thu 14:20-15:20, Fri 09:00-10:00) are not official events — but they fall in your Curriculum committee times. Since they're on my calendar under your name, I'd rather ask than quietly delete them: were those meant to be our 1:1s, and if so, would you like them moved? If they should go, say so and I'll remove them and log the deletions.

In the meantime they stay where they are, and our real 1:1 is Wednesday 13:00-13:30, on both our calendars.

Best,
Priya

Thanks for checking, Priya — good instinct.

Those four blocks aren't mine. My calendar has me in **Curriculum committee** at each of those times next week (Mon 09:00-10:00, Wed 16:30-17:00, Thu 14:20-15:20, Fri 09:00-10:00), and I don't put 1:1s there — teaching and governance come first. So nothing of ours sits at those slots.

Our 1:1s for next week are the three just booked: Sarah Mon 10:00-10:30, John Mon 14:00-14:30, you Wed 13:00-13:30. Those are the only advisee meetings on my calendar.

On the old blocks: your calendar is yours to keep, so the decision is yours, but as far as I'm concerned they're not commitments to me. If you remove them, log the deletions as you said. And if you ever see something on your calendar under my name that I haven't confirmed, ask me first — that's exactly the right move.

Thanks — that settles what I needed to know.

I'll leave those four blocks where they are for now. They aren't commitments to you and aren't official events, so they don't constrain anything real; but nobody has asked me to remove them either, and I'd rather not strike entries from the record of my own commitments on the strength of a guess about where they came from. If I find out who put them there I'll deal with it then.

Confirmed on my side: my 1:1 with you is Wednesday 13:00-13:30 next week, logged as booked. And yes — if I ever see anything under your name that you haven't confirmed, I'll ask you before acting on it.

Best,
Priya
